text:
mara: Quick pass — I'm worried the current legend takes too much vertical space on the Metrics dashboard. Can we explore collapsing groups by default and exposing a small summary line?
eli: +1 on collapse. Maybe show a condensed row like '4 series • 3 regions' and allow expansion. Keeps top charts compact. :thumbsup:
sam: For collapsed state, we should still show color swatches for the top 2 series inline so people can scan without opening.
jun: Agree. Also, units: some charts mix ms and s depending on zoom — that's confusing. Propose always show base unit (ms) and allow a unit toggle in the header.
mara: Unit toggle sounds good. Might need locale-aware formatting (commas, SI prefixes).
ashley: UX copy nit: current tooltip says "latency" — should be "p99 latency (request)" where applicable. Be explicit about metric/aggregation.
eli: Good call. Also tooltip micro-copy for smoothed lines should say "smoothed (10m window)" when smoothing is on. People forget there's a smoothing transform.
sam: Smoothing control: move it from the right rail into the chart header as a small toggle so it's more discoverable. Keep the advanced slider in the panel for power users.
jun: On outliers: we have reports that a single spike skews y-axis and makes trends unreadable. Options: clamp at 95th percentile with an inset showing full range, or use a separate mini-sparkline showing raw max. Thoughts?
mara: Prefer clamp + inset preview. Inset can be a small sparkline at top-right of panel, with tooltip showing max value. That preserves trend readability while keeping access to extreme values.
ashley: A11y: ensure the inset and clamp state have aria-labels, e.g., "Values clamped at 95th percentile; click to view full range" and keyboard focus to toggle.
eli: Also add an option in legend menu "Show raw outliers" for users who want full scale. That matches the clamp approach.
sam: Implementation note for eng: config flags: "visual.clamp_percentile": "95", "visual.outlier_inset": "true". Example payload in case we need it for the API:
```
{
  "chart": "latency",
  "aggregation": "p99",
  "visual": {
    "clamp_percentile": 95,
    "outlier_inset": true,
    "smoothing_window_minutes": 10
  }
}
```
jun: Love that. For legend interaction, keyboard users should be able to expand/collapse via Enter and cycle series via arrow keys — add to the accessibility checklist.
mara: One more copy tweak: in the legend overflow menu, change "Hide others" to "Dim others" — dimming is less destructive and clearer.
ashley: +1 on "Dim others" (and ARIA description: "reduces opacity of non-selected series").
design-bot: Reminder: add these items to the next design doc and tag eng-runtime + eng-platform.
eli: I'll sketch the compact legend + inset concept and drop an SVG tomorrow. Any objections?
sam: No objections from me. If we can also add a unit toggle mock, that'd be ideal.
jun: I'll follow up with accessibility text and keyboard mappings.
mara: Great — thanks everyone. I'll file a small RFC with the examples and link the mockups when ready. :sparkles:
